reviewScope.inspection: Read actual two-file diff and source-only unchanged caller/closure evidence. No imports/AST/tests/Node/SQL/process/native/Docker starts or source edits.

references: connect-local500.py146–147 injects runtimeMemory.beforeExport into the start of metadata().
Original measure-runtime.js28 calls obs.metadata() in object spread before evaluating failure:obs.failure(error).
native-node-budget.js97–106 can throw from GC validation/output bound/fs.writeSync; short writes explicitly throw.
connect-local500.py156–158 only catches close() failure in finally and emits fixed CLOSE_FAILED; it does not retain the incoming workload error.
blockingFindings.exactPath: Workload rejects with original error E → measure-runtime catch begins constructing result → obs.metadata invokes beforeExport → diagnostic error D (for example the explicitly implemented SHORT_WRITE) throws before failure(E) is evaluated → catch itself rejects with D; existing bounded failure/stderr for E is never emitted. finally attempts close and may emit only CLOSE_FAILED. Native/stage exit remains a failure, but original failure evidence is lost.
blockingFindings.requestedBoundedCorrection: Preserve the original bounded error before the new potentially failing observation in the failure path; report any diagnostic error separately and terminally. Do not continue to PASS, loosen acceptance, swallow a failed observer, or replace the original cause with it. Root owns the exact minimal implementation and qualification.
blockingFindings.sourceOnlyReproduction: Logical control-flow proof from unchanged catch evaluation order plus the newly throwing call. No execution performed.

nonBlockingFindings.observation: before-final-export is taken while evaluating obs.metadata(), before assess-runtime constructs unitReports, slices/checks arrays and other result fields. The interval to after-final-export includes assessment, JSON stringify/Buffer/write, promise completion and possible lifetime changes.
nonBlockingFindings.claimLimit: It cannot be labeled a measurement of JSON serialization cost alone. No direct per-allocation or common-peak ownership is established.

nonBlockingFindings.observation: process.memoryUsage/getHeapStatistics/getHeapSpaceStatistics are sequential builtin calls with one timestamp after them. RSS includes all threads; heap/external/space counters represent the sampled main isolate. The sources do not make the frame an atomic cgroup/process/V8 snapshot.
nonBlockingFindings.claimLimit: Use descriptive trends and explicit flags; never add space physical to heap physical/RSS or subtract these as exact native ownership.

nonBlockingFindings.observation: Natural GC entries are counted since this observer was installed; takeRecords consumes queued entries without forcing GC. Counts/durations are cumulative per allowed kind with no retained per-GC history. gcCallbacksMayLag is explicit; final disconnect does not prove all GC occurring during the final sample was delivered.
nonBlockingFindings.claimLimit: No exact post-GC stage equality, full-process-since-start GC coverage, plateau, peak owner or saving follows.

nonBlockingFindings.observation: Cardinalities cover requests/mutations/scopes/validations/predecessors/units/events/errors only. Fixtures, responses, providerPhases and the one retained command are not separately counted.
nonBlockingFindings.claimLimit: These are eight named observed collections, not a complete object census.
